coordinate_system.case_origin: Outer bottom corner corresponding to PCB origin offset; X along30mm, Y along32mm, Z upward through thickness
coordinate_system.wire_exit_definition: Center of insulated wire at connector housing wire-exit plane, not header Fab/courtyard edge
coordinate_system.free_length_definition: Completed battery pack top edge to connector wire-exit housing face; no housing length subtraction, no tension
coordinate_system.pack_exit_datum: Unmated pack coordinates: origin at lower-left-bottom corner of completed pack; X across width, Y toward wire exit along length, Z through thickness. Measure each wire center separately.
coordinate_system.housing_exit_datum: Unmated housing coordinates: origin at pin-1-side outer corner on housing bottom and wire-exit face. X across pin row, Y inward toward mating body, Z above housing bottom; photo must identify origin and axes.
coordinate_system.legacy_exit_fields: Existing exit_case_* fields refer to assembled case. Shared Y/Z are legacy summaries only; do not infer equal wire coordinates from them.

procedure: Before energizing or mating, identify pin1 from housing datum and compare red+/black- with J2 pin assignment; photograph battery label, lot and orientation.
Measure pack W/L/T and each exposed lead length with no tension. Record wire OD gently without flattening insulation. Leave unmeasurable fields blank and explain in notes.

Before a PCB is available, record battery-side exit coordinates in pack-local axes and connector-side exits in housing-local axes for each of the three wires separately, with unmated top/side photos, instrument and measurement uncertainty. Do not populate assembled-case fields from these local coordinates.

With PCB fixed at the documented case datum, seat connector vertically using the housing. Measure wire-center exit X/Y/Z using calibrated optical or height measurement; do not infer Z from mated connector overall height.
Photograph the assembled lead route with a scale in both top and side views. Record any extra loop, terminal loading, interference or necessary forced deformation.
Close and reopen the lid without forcing it. Inspect all three leads and housing for pinch/contact damage. Check assembled external dimensions including protrusions.
Repeat for all5 purchased packs unmodified; do not cut, reterminate or solder leads to make a fit pass.

required_evidence: All measurements or explicit unresolved reason
Measured exit datums compared to regenerated CAD route
acceptance.allowable_wire_bend_radius: Must come from applicable wire/assembly specification or validated assembly process; visual fit alone does not establish allowable radius.

decision_rules: A failed or missing item prevents fit approval for that sample; never average away one failed pack.
Five samples characterize those packs only and do not prove all manufacturer length tolerances.
Use observed exit coordinates to update CAD, then separately assess tolerance extremes and insertion/removal paths.
Physical test execution remains pending purchased prototypes; this document is the plan, not permission to purchase.
Unmated measurements can reduce CAD uncertainty before board fabrication; empty mated/closure fields stay pending and never count as a failed or passed pre-board measurement stage.
